mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI increases are not followed by tightening monetary policy within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increases are not followed by a broader economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS declines are not followed by a broader economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases are not followed by a broader economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a rise in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases > 100k MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the labor market deterioration is not followed by a broader economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases are not followed by a broader economic recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and GDPC1 increases > 1% QoQ
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of monetary easing and GDP growth is not followed by a broader economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% YoY and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp YoY
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of increased production and lower unemployment is not followed by a broader economic expansion.
